annotations.title: US forecast for up to 8 places in one call (NWS)

description: US forecast for up to 8 places in one call (NWS) — National Weather Service 7-day forecast for up to 8 US locations at once, plus a comparison: warmest next period, coldest low this week, wettest next 48 hours and fewest rainy days. points = name=lat,lon entries separated by ; or | (name optional). Each location returns the nearest city, current period, day/night highs and lows, precipitation chance, wind and rainy days. Places outside NWS coverage get a per-item error. Public-domain NWS data, Fahrenheit. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_forecast_batch
